capabilities: Capture and edit tasks from one window using natural-language recognition
Manage tasks in a GTD workspace with date, status, project, and person views
Assign vault-wide focus positions and one flagged next action per project
Bulk-edit dates, priorities, projects, people, and statuses with guarded undo
Generate daily journals and weekly or monthly reviews automatically or manually
disambiguation: Not a Dutch translation of the Tasks plugin; it is a standalone tool that can run alongside Tasks using compatible task metadata.
extras: Also installable via BRAT or manual file copy; no external service is used and vault content is not sent over the network.
motivation: The plugin was created especially for Dutch, with date, project, and person recognition phrases in Dutch.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in natural-language task parsing and no GTD-style workspace, so users must write task metadata by hand and build their own review views.

relations.evidence: The Tasks Community Plugin is not required, but Tasks NL uses compatible task metadata
Dataview is only needed if you enable the live focus 1–3 or project-next-action lists

summary: Natural-language task capture and GTD workspace that stores tasks as standard Markdown, with focus ranks, bulk edits, and automated journals and reviews.
